label: preparing
what: A secret surprise feast honoring the mayor's forty years of service, planned for day 1 at 18:00 in the town hall great hall: 200 fresh loaves and eight installed lanterns. Builder, baker, freight and innkeeper coordinated baking, funding, grain transport, lighting and bread delivery. Neighbour knowingly helped by arranging the mayor's attendance under the description of an ordinary chat and concealing the celebration. The record confirms the bread and lighting were ready. The mayor was told of the meeting, but no record shows him being told of the feast or its purpose; secretary's scheduling assistance is not evidence of knowing involvement.
